diff --git a/greeting.go b/greeting.go
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/greeting.go
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+package feature
+
+func Greeting(name string) string {
+	return "Hello, " + name
+}
diff --git a/greeting_test.go b/greeting_test.go
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/greeting_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+package feature
+
+import "testing"
+
+func TestGreeting(t *testing.T) {
+	if got := Greeting("Ada"); got != "Hello, Ada" {
+		t.Fatalf("Greeting() = %q", got)
+	}
+}

text: Added Greeting with its focused test.
